title: Add delete button to remove Stripe configuration

requirements.summary: Add a 'Delete Stripe Configuration' button to the StripeSetup component that allows the admin to remove the stored Stripe API key and reset the Stripe configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button is visible in the StripeSetup component when Stripe is already configured
Button is labeled 'Delete Stripe Configuration' or similar clear text
Clicking the button shows a confirmation dialog before deletion
Confirmation dialog warns that deleting will disable payment processing
After confirmation, the button calls the backend to remove the Stripe configuration

file_operations.description: Add a 'Delete Stripe Configuration' button that appears when Stripe is already configured. The button should trigger a confirmation dialog (using shadcn/ui AlertDialog component) that warns the user about disabling payment processing. On confirmation, call the useDeleteStripeConfig mutation hook. Position the button below the success indicator when configuration exists. Use destructive button styling to indicate the dangerous action.

requirements.summary: Create a React Query mutation hook useDeleteStripeConfig that calls the backend deleteStripeConfig method and invalidates the Stripe configuration cache after successful deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Hook is named useDeleteStripeConfig and follows the existing React Query mutation pattern
Hook requires admin authentication via the actor
After successful deletion, the hook invalidates the 'stripeConfig' query cache
Hook includes proper error handling and shows toast notifications on success/failure

file_operations.description: Add a new mutation hook named useDeleteStripeConfig that follows the existing pattern in the file. The hook should call actor.deleteStripeConfig() with admin authentication check. On success, invalidate the 'stripeConfig' query key using queryClient.invalidateQueries. Show a success toast notification confirming deletion and an error toast on failure. Follow the same structure as other mutation hooks in this file.

requirements.summary: Update the StripeSetup component to refresh the configuration status after deletion and show the configuration form again when Stripe settings are removed
acceptanceCriteria: After successful deletion, the green checkmark status indicator is hidden
The Stripe configuration form becomes visible and editable again
A success toast notification confirms the deletion
The form is ready for the admin to enter new Stripe credentials if needed

file_operations.description: Update the component to conditionally render the success indicator and configuration form based on the isStripeConfigured query result. When the deleteStripeConfig mutation succeeds, the invalidated query will automatically refetch and update the UI state. Ensure the green checkmark and 'Stripe is configured' message are hidden when isStripeConfigured returns false, and the configuration form (secret key and countries inputs) becomes visible and editable. The toast notification is already handled by the mutation hook in useQueries.ts.
